description.value: Two-layer support stand (rigid weldment, no movable joints). Two posts 220 mm apart and 310 mm tall, bridged by a tall rear plate and two horizontal shelves (lower top ~54 mm, upper top ~304 mm; 250 mm inter-shelf gap). The gap was widened by lowering the bottom shelf (so the upper-shelf pick height is unchanged), sized so a top-down gripper can enter from the open side instead of a near-singular horizontal tuck (docs/refactor.md R6). Shelves are 140 mm deep so an ~80 mm object rests with clearance and the gripper fingers can reach in. Bolts to the floor through foot plates with 4x Oe6.5 mm mounting holes. Authored at true metric scale (metric_scale 1.0, no scenario scaling). Authored by articraft from 2-layer-supporter.png; kinematics (none) live in model.urdf, this metadata carries only RoboSmith semantic annotations. Static support fixture, not a graspable target.
